name: ui_rec
meaning: pointer to the active band/UI record passed in er0 (rec); rec+1 = screen id, rec+0 = previous screen
evidence: doc 35 / screens.tsv header; every handler uses er0

name: REC_B_SLOT
meaning: B-slot (sub band) record; several dials refuse or branch when rec == FF90F0

name: menu_level
meaning: setup-menu level: 0 = item list, 1 = item open, 2+ = editing; in text editors also the cursor column

name: menu_ctx_live
meaning: 1 = edit context live, 0 = stacked in AD9E..ADA0 (nested editor)

name: menu_ctx_saved_level
meaning: stacked AD68

name: nested_stage
meaning: nested-edit stage (1/2 select pop, other values post key 4)

name: menu_subpage
meaning: setup sub-page (2 = open, AD6B = key that opened it); most setup keys are refused while nonzero

name: subpage_key_AD6B
meaning: key/digit that opened the sub-page

name: confirm_pending
meaning: BACK swallowed once after a confirm prompt (tone 0x46)

name: sub_cursor_AD99
meaning: sub-cursor inside the auto-reply editor (call col / text col)

name: char_mode_AD81
meaning: 1 = character step offers '*' (wildcard charset)

name: pw_buf_AD88
meaning: PASSWORD edit digits; AD8A..AD8D = 4-digit code copied to FF896C

name: seq_buf_AD8E
meaning: typed-digit unlock buffer compared as one long

name: ui_AD92
meaning: working copy of FF898C (screen 0x79 band bitmap)

name: ui_AD94
meaning: band of the record when screen 0x79 opened

name: text_buf_AD6E
meaning: 16-char text edit buffer

name: text_ADA2
meaning: BEACON STATUS TEXT edit buffer

name: ar_text_ADDE
meaning: APRS auto-reply text

name: key_event
meaning: key code mailbox (0xFF = consumed; 4/6 synthesized cursor keys)

name: key_flags
meaning: b0 = dial direction down / CCW, b7 = long press

name: key_digit
meaning: digit of a keypad key (0 = none)

name: ui_flags
meaning: b6 = value changed (exit handler saves, then clears), b7 = item opened / char edited, b3 = apply lamp

name: ui_flags_AA31
meaning: b2 = coarse step in RPT SHIFT FREQ editor (cleared on pop)

name: ui_flags_AA34
meaning: b6 = PASSWORD edited

name: ui_flags_AA37
meaning: b2 gates screens 0xD4/0xD5 and nullsub_30; b6 cleared by B-slot squelch

name: dial_scratch
meaning: scratch byte the step records point at when a record field is edited

name: tone_ev
meaning: tone / prompt mailbox (0x39 beep preview, 0x16 unlock ok, 0x46 prompt, 0x1D reject)

name: edit_row_B054
meaning: editor row, reset 0 on entry/exit

name: edit_col_B055
meaning: editor column, reset 1

name: edit_cursor
meaning: edit cursor / selected slot

name: edit_cursor_max
meaning: shadow of B3F4 (list selection)

name: edit_sub_flags
meaning: b0 = sub-edit active (BACK calls sub_214BA)

name: list_top_A4F5
meaning: first visible row of multi-row editors

name: win_mode_B091
meaning: 1 = page-mode window scroll

name: ui_9542
meaning: cursor-blink / edit timer (0x96 after a char change)

name: setup_group
meaning: 0-based setup group of the item list

name: ui_mode_8F2C
meaning: UI mode word (0x10 enables the 08030706 sequence)

name: node_mode
meaning: node / PC-keyed mode; many dials refused when nonzero

name: band_sel
meaning: b6 = band B active; b4 = mirror squelch to the other band

name: slot_chk
meaning: b0 = B record in use

name: comm_mode_a
meaning: band-A comm mode (1 = digital: suppress reprogram request)

name: comm_mode_b
meaning: band-B comm mode

name: tx_state
meaning: 0 idle, nonzero transmitting

name: tx_req_flag
meaning: reprogram code posted while transmitting

name: tsearch_a_state
meaning: tone-search state band A (1 start, 3 stop)

name: tsearch_a_active
meaning: tone search running band A

name: tsearch_b_state
meaning: tone-search state band B

name: tsearch_b_active
meaning: tone search running band B

name: r1_base
meaning: EEPROM region R1 image; R1 n -> FF8920+n, EEPROM 0x580+n

name: r2_base
meaning: EEPROM region R2 image; R2 n -> FF8AA0+n, EEPROM 0xC000+n

name: r3_base
meaning: EEPROM region R3 image; R3 n -> FF8D20+n, EEPROM 0xD000+n

name: r1_set_89BE
meaning: R1 0x9E bit flags (b1 SQL EXPANSION, b3 RPT ARS, b5 SCAN LAMP, b7 VFO MODE ...)

name: r1_set_89BF
meaning: R1 0x9F bit flags (b4 BCLO ...)

name: r1_set_89C0
meaning: R1 0xA0 bit flags (b0 MONI/T-CALL, b7 gates RPT ARS)

name: r1_set_89C1
meaning: R1 0xA1 bit flags (b0 MEMORY WRITE, b2 MEMORY PROTECT, b3 KEY LOCK)

name: r1_set_89C2
meaning: R1 0xA2 bit flags (b0 password on, b1 LANGUAGE, b4 WX ALERT, b6 12/24h)

name: r1_set_89C3
meaning: R1 0xA3 bit flags (b0 PRIORITY REVERT, b3 HOME VFO ...)

name: r1_set_89C4
meaning: R1 0xA4 feature flags (b1/b2/b3 group13/b4 RAM DISPLAY), b0 toggled by screen 0x67

name: r1_set_89C5
meaning: R1 0xA5 bit flags (b0 TARGET LOCATION, b7 LAMP field)

name: r1_set_89A4
meaning: LCD DIMMER level

name: r1_set_89B4
meaning: screens 0xD4 (b4-6) / 0xD5 (b0-2)

name: r1_set_8936
meaning: DTMF memory slot

name: r1_sql_8970
meaning: SQL LEVEL band A (8971 band B, 8972/8973 AM)

name: att_bitmap_8976
meaning: per-memory-channel ANT ATT bitmap

name: r1_set_898C_w
meaning: band bitmap edited on screen 0x79

name: r1_set_898E_w
meaning: word setting 0..0x7F8 step 8 (screen 0xD6)

name: r1_pw_896C
meaning: PASSWORD code

name: r2_callsign_8AA2
meaning: APRS callsign; FF8AA8 = SSID

name: r2_set_8AAB
meaning: APRS bits (b1 SmartBeacon, b6 AUTO beacon, b0/b3/b7 AF DUAL/MUTE/GPS TIME SET)

name: r2_aprs_filter_8AAE
meaning: APRS filter mask (8AAF b0 continues it)

name: aprs_pos_src
meaning: position source: 0 GPS, 1/2 manual, >=3 stored slot

name: r2_sb_type_8BCC
meaning: SmartBeaconing type (0 = off)

name: beacon_mode_A90C
meaning: beacon mode 0/1 AUTO/2 SMART

name: sb_edit_A90E
meaning: SmartBeaconing parameter edit block (A90E low, A90F high speed)

name: r2_digipath_8BE5
meaning: DIGI PATH type (>=3 full path)

name: r2_digi_hop_8AC2
meaning: selected hop (7-byte entries from table 0x0186F6)

name: r2_sym_set_8C1E
meaning: symbol set (3 = user)

name: r2_symbol_8AA1
meaning: symbol code (0xC4 = user-defined)

name: r2_com_8C26
meaning: COM PORT: b7 STATUS, b0 INPUT

name: r2_com_8C2A
meaning: COM PORT Mic-E/POSITION/WEATHER/OBJECT/ITEM bits

name: r2_ar_call_8CFC
meaning: auto-reply to-call (wildcards allowed)

name: msg_text_A574
meaning: APRS message compose text (A56C/A56D call, A573 SSID)

name: rtc_edit_A9CC
meaning: DATE & TIME edit image (BCD); A9C4 = clock image

name: PORT_FBA5
meaning: port pull-up register; low nibble set for screen 0x42, cleared on exit

name: PORT_52
meaning: output port; b5 = inverse of rec+0x12.4 (RF path)

name: IO_FE90
meaning: serial register zeroed before reopening the COM port (FE92 too)
